name: Scott Gaspard
bio:
I've been helping people buy and sell homes in south Louisiana since 1998. Over those years I've learned that a good move comes down to two things: knowing the market cold, and knowing your client. I price homes carefully, negotiate with your best interest in mind, and keep you informed at every step, so the decisions you make are the right ones for your family. Our clients have given the Gaspard Team more than 260 five-star reviews on Zillow, and that trust is what I work for every day. In 2026 I opened Gaspard & Co Real Estate to bring together some of the area's most experienced agents under one roof.

My wife Jessica and I have 13 kids, so I understand what a move means for a household.
